title: Build the assembler
lead: `arena asm bot.s`: turn assembly source into a cell list, with labels, expressions, and errors that carry line and column.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the disassembler (next slice); running matches.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 2 and acceptance criterion C17: the assembler rejects malformed input with line and column errors.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Assembler package source and tests.
- `docs/spec/asm.md` (new): the assembly syntax.
- The `arena asm` subcommand in the CLI package.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Valid programs assemble to the expected cells, covering every opcode, modifier and addressing mode.
- Forward and backward label references.
- Expressions evaluate as the syntax doc defines.
- Each malformed case errors with the exact line and column: unknown opcode, bad addressing mode, undefined label, duplicate label, malformed expression.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Gap: PROJECT.md asks for labels and expressions but does not define the syntax, the expression operators, or the `arena asm` output format. The implementer proposes them in `docs/spec/asm.md` for owner review before coding.
- Hand-written lexer and parser; no parser dependency (C13).
- Output cells use the VM core cell type.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `arena asm` on a malformed file exits non-zero and prints `file:line:col: message`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-assembler` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
